text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Moments before the decisive battle that is the autumn Tenno Sho, Mejiro Ardan reveals that she feels blessed to have made this journey with me by her side.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She also reminisces about everything she's been through with her cherished rivals, Sakura Chiyono O and Yaeno Muteki.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Finally, she prepares to take on the autumn Tenno Sho—the focus of a history meant to be.
